description: Vue 3.5+ API to register a cleanup that runs before the watcher re-runs and when it stops. Call it before the first `await`.
Third argument of the `watch` callback (first of `watchEffect`). Older API, bound to its watcher so it also works after `await`.
When a watcher runs: before the re-render (default), after it (sees the updated DOM), or synchronously on every change.
Web API that cancels a `fetch`: pass `controller.signal` to the request and call `controller.abort()`.
